def slots(start, end, step=30):
    t = start
    while t < end:
        yield t
        t += step

gen = slots(540, 630)
print(next(gen))
print(next(gen))
for t in gen:
    print("loop got", t)
nums = iter([10, 20])
print(next(nums), next(nums), next(nums, "done"))
squares = (n * n for n in range(4))
print(sum(squares), list(squares))

def morning():
    yield "9:00"
    yield "9:30"

def day():
    yield from morning()
    yield "14:00"

print(list(day()))
